entities.summary: The Los Andes Peruvian University (UPLA) is an educational institution created on December 30, 1983. The main campus is situated in Huancayo, Peru. It is one of the most prosperous universities in the central region of the country. It is named after the Andes mountains, which surround the city of Huancayo.
